law.title: Driving on highway having multiple marked lanes for traffic (1)(b)
law.text: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

activation_conditions: the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes in the subject's direction
the subject moves out of its lane
residue: 'ascertained … with safety' is a judgement element about the driver's check; the observable substitute is the gap the target lane offered
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the signal precedes the lane change — the indicator must be on before the footprint starts to leave the lane
a lead time or distance for the signal must be declared; the text says only 'has given'
